sanskrit: yā śatrūn prāśaṃjayā sahamānābhibhūr asi | sāmūn pratiprāśo jahy arasān kṛṇv oṣadhe ||
english: O herb, thou who art the over-conquering victor that has crushed enemies — strike down these same ones in counter-attack, rendering them powerless.

sanskrit: suparṇas tvānv avindat sūkaras tvākhanan nasā | indras tvā cakre bāhvor asurebhya starītave ||
english: The eagle Suparṇa tracked thee out; the boar dug thee up with his snout; Indra placed thee in his arms to spread thee against the Asuras.

sanskrit: pāṭām indro vy āśnād dhantavā asurebhyaḥ | tayāhaṃ śatrūn sākṣīya- -indraḥ śālāvṛkān iva ||
english: Indra devoured the pāṭā plant in order to slay the Asuras; with that same herb may I overcome my enemies, as Indra overcame the hyenas.

sanskrit: rudra jalāṣabheṣaja nīlaśikhaṇḍa karmakṛt | praśnaṃ durasyato jahi yo asmām̐ abhidāsati ||
english: O Rudra, healer with cooling medicine, blue-crested, active doer — strike down the hostile inquiry of him who assails us.

sanskrit: tasya praśnaṃ tvaṃ jahi yo na indrābhidāsati | adhi no brūhi śaktibhiḥ prāśi mām uttaraṃ kṛdhi ||
english: Strike down the hostile inquiry of him who assails us with Indra's might; speak over us with thy powers; consume him, and make me the superior.

sanskrit: yathedaṃ bhūmyā adhi vātas tṛṇaṃ mathāyati | evā mathnāmi te mano yathā māṃ kāminy aso yathā mām anv āyasi ||
english: As the wind churns the grass upon the earth, so do I churn thy mind, so that thou shalt be in love with me, so that thou shalt follow after me.

sanskrit: eyam agan patikāmā janikāmo 'ham āgamam | aśvaḥ kanikradad yathā bhagenāhaṃ sahāgamam ||
english: She has come here yearning for a husband; I have come yearning for a wife. As a neighing stallion, so have I come together with her through the grace of Bhaga.

sanskrit: saṃ cen nayātho aśvinā kāminā saṃ ca neṣathaḥ | saṃ vāṃ manāṃsy agmata saṃ cakṣūṃṣi sam u vratā ||
english: O Aśvins, ye have brought together these two who are in love, and ye shall lead them together; may your minds come together, your eyes come together, and your vows come together.

sanskrit: yad antaraṃ tad bāhyaṃ yad bāhyaṃ tad antaram | kanyānāṃ viśvarūpāṇāṃ mano gṛbhāyauṣadhe ||
english: What is within, let that be without; what is without, let that be within — O herb, seize the mind of the maidens of all forms.

sanskrit: ?yāsuparṇāpakṣaṇavā- -ānapakṣaṇavā? | atrā ta ārpitaṃ manaḥ śalya iva kurmalaṃ yathā ||
english: [Uncertain text: she of the eagle-winged — she without wings —] here thy mind is fixed, as an arrow transfixes a young bud.

sanskrit: siṃhe vyāghra uta yā pṛdākau tviṣir agnau brāhmaṇe sūrye yā | indraṃ yā devī subhagā vavardha sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā ||
english: The fiery splendor that is in the lion, in the tiger, and in the pṛdāku serpent, that is in fire, in the brahmin, and in the sun — the auspicious goddess by whom Indra was augmented: may she come to us, united with radiant glory.

sanskrit: (yā) hastini dvīpini yā hiraṇye tviṣir aśveṣu puruṣeṣu goṣu | (…) ||
english: The fiery splendor that is in the elephant, in the leopard, and in gold, that is in horses, in men, and in cattle — [may she come to us, united with radiant glory].

sanskrit: (yā) rājanye dundubhāv āyatāyāṃ tviṣiḥ senāyāṃ stanayitnau ghoṣe yā | (…) ||
english: The fiery splendor that is in the warrior-noble, in the battle-drum when it is stretched, in an army on the march, in the thunder, and in the war-cry — [may she come to us, united with radiant glory].

sanskrit: rathe akṣeṣv ṛṣabhasya vāje parjanye vāte varuṇasya śuṣme | indraṃ yā devī subhagā vavardha (…) ||
english: In the chariot, in the axles, in the swift charge of the bull, in Parjanya, in the wind, in the might of Varuṇa — the auspicious goddess by whom Indra was augmented [may she come to us, united with radiant glory].

sanskrit: yā rudreṣu yā vasuṣv ādityeṣu marutsu yā | tviṣir yā viśveṣu deveṣu sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā ||
english: The fiery splendor that is among the Rudras, that is among the Vasus, among the Ādityas, among the Maruts — the splendor that is among all the gods: may she come to us, united with radiant glory.
